appearance_facts.fact: Chart title reads 'Advertising Budget vs Revenue (High-Performing Regions)'.
Five blue circular markers form a single rising diagonal series from lower-left to upper-right.
Markers are labeled January, February, March, April, May in that left-to-right order.
The May marker is the highest and rightmost point, positioned above the April marker.

printed_facts.fact: Month labels present: January, February, March, April, May.

public_definitions: Task: 'Review the regional advertising dashboard, then submit the budget increase decision.'
Primary field 'Budget Approval Decision' options: 'Hold and request full-data analysis', 'Approve broader budget increase', 'Reject budget increase request'.
Companion selects: Recommendation area, Review record, Decision queue (each with one enabled value).
uncertain: No legend, threshold, or explicit approval rule is printed on the dashboard.
Exact numeric values for each month are not annotated; only axis positions are visible.
